recent_rule: matched date >= reference date minus 6 calendar months; boundary included, month-end clamped; fixed batch date
coverage: every matching stock-day in the selected date range, with no maximum list length
selection: latest accepted date; if none, latest whole-curve candidate explicitly labeled rejected
three_session_rule: reference-day remainder counts as day 1; through day 3 postmarket close
high_low: maximum High and minimum Low over all expected forward hourly OHLC slots
unknown: incomplete three-session paths stay visible with observed-only outcomes; excluded from full three-session summaries
aggregation: equal weight per matched date within each recency group; overlapping samples not independent
line_style_assignment: recent dates newest-first, repeating after eight; older lines solid; SVG legend uses same dash pattern
current_view_forward_aggregation: accepted dates under active method only
